Subject: CloudLattice trial — onboarding (invoice-only request)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — really excited to get CloudLattice integrated for the three-week pilot with your platform. Our billing team asked me to check whether Redwood can onboard us under an invoice-only path for the duration of the trial. The expected run rate is low (~$1,200/month) and we prefer monthly invoicing rather than issuing a PO for a short pilot.

Attached: CL-Quote-02-2025.pdf, W9-CloudLattice.pdf

If there are security or evidence requirements you need for a temporary exception, please let me know what we should upload and we can turn it around quickly. Happy to sign a short addendum if that helps.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships, CloudLattice
elena@cloudlattice.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Subject: Fwd: CloudLattice trial — onboarding (invoice-only request)

Team — forwarding CloudLattice's onboarding ask. They want a temporary invoice-only onboarding for a short pilot (see attached quote + W9). Run rate small (~$1,200/mo).

Questions:
- Can procurement/finance approve a temporary no-PO path for trials under ~ $5k/month?
- What evidence do we require (insurance, SOC doc, contract addendum, PO-exemption form)?
- Any GL coding or flagging we should apply so this is visible during review?

Marissa: putting you on the thread so Sales knows what the gating items are for pilot activation.

Quoted below.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Feb 2025 13:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CloudLattice trial — onboarding (invoice-only request)

Hi all — thanks for the ping, Vivek. Procurement can support a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots under specific controls. To move forward we need the following items from CloudLattice (acceptable as PDFs in the vendor intake folder):

1) Completed vendor intake form (we can pre-fill some fields)
2) Signed short-term T&Cs / addendum covering trial scope (we can draft)
3) W9 (received)
4) Certificate of insurance (general liability) or written confirmation of coverage
5) Point-of-contact for AR and a billing email (accounts@cloudlattice.com is fine)
6) A maximum monthly cap confirmed in writing (proposed: $5,000/month for the first 90 days)

Operational mitigations we will apply if approved:
- Tag as "TEMP_INVOICE_ONLY" in the vendor record and route invoices to a procurement review queue.
- Limit automatic payment approval to invoices <= $5k; anything above requires a PO.
- 90-day pilot window with a maximum of two renewals by exception.

I'll attach the procurement-evidence-checklist.xlsx (stub) to this thread; please ask Elena to upload items 1–4. Once I have the checklist items, procurement will confirm and route to finance for final signoff.

--
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Feb 2025 15:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CloudLattice trial — onboarding (invoice-only request)

Priya / Vivek — Finance is comfortable granting a temporary no-PO exception under the following conditions:

1) Trial window: up to 90 days; cap at $5,000/month.
2) Payment terms: Net-30 from invoice date; monthly invoicing only.
3) Vendor record must be flagged (TEMP_INVOICE_ONLY) and have GL coding assigned before any payment.
4) Procurement to confirm receipt of insurance and W9.
5) No automatic renewals — any extension beyond 90 days requires explicit approval from Procurement and Finance.

I'll approve routing invoices under these constraints. Procurement, please confirm when the vendor record is set up so AP knows to accept monthly invoices without a PO for this vendor during the window.

Thanks,
David Kim
Sr. Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudlattice.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudLattice Billing <accounts@cloudlattice.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: CloudLattice trial — onboarding (invoice-only request)

Hi Vivek / Priya / David — thanks, that works for us. We'll upload the completed vendor intake, the signed addendum, and the insurance certificate within 48 hours. We confirm a cap of $5,000/month for the pilot and agree to Net-30 terms and monthly invoicing.

Attached: W9-CloudLattice.pdf (already shared)

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Let me know if you want the addendum signed by legal first; we can coordinate.

Best,
Elena
Head of Partnerships, CloudLattice
